title: What Do You Do? (Work & Study)

expressions.meaning: O que você faz? (qual é o seu trabalho)
expressions.example: What do you do? — I fix GPS systems on tractors.

expressions.expr: I work from Monday to Friday.
expressions.meaning: Eu trabalho de segunda a sexta.
expressions.example: I work from Monday to Friday at GPS Tronic.
I work all day and I study agronomy at night.
I read manuals, but I don't speak much English.

sentences: I fix GPS systems on tractors.
He checks the antennas every day.
My boss talks to the customers.
Yes, he does. He works here.

grammar.title: Padrão: falar da sua rotina (work / works)
rules: Para I, you, we, they o verbo fica puro: I work, I study, we fix.
Para he, she, it o verbo ganha -s ou -es: He works, he checks, he fixes, he studies.
⚠️ Na pergunta (Do/Does) e na negativa (don't/doesn't), o verbo volta a ficar puro: Does Pedro work here?
A resposta curta repete o do/does: Yes, I do. / Yes, he does. / No, he doesn't.

quiz.a: He checks the antennas every day.
opts: He checks the antennas every day.
He check the antennas every day.
He is check the antennas every day.
He checking the antennas every day.
quiz.why: Com he, she ou it na rotina, o verbo ganha -s: checks.
O -s já está no Does, então o verbo work fica puro.
Verbos terminados em -x, -ch, -sh, -s ou -o ganham -es com he/she/it.

opts: I am study agronomy at night.
quiz.why: Com I o verbo fica puro (study), e 'à noite' é sempre at night.

quiz.why: A resposta curta em inglês repete o auxiliar da pergunta: Do you...? -> Yes, I do.
